name: WorkOS
title: workos.com
shortDescription: WorkOS is a developer-first platform that enables apps to quickly integrate enterprise features such as single sign-on, directory sync, and multi-factor authentication. Designed for developers, it simplifies the process of making applications enterprise-ready with minimal coding, targeting software developers and businesses aiming to scale into larger corporate environments. An example use case is a SaaS provider looking to offer enterprise-grade security features to their clients efficiently.
pros: Supports a wide range of identity providers
cons: Potential dependency on a third-party service
